submitted.rationale: All five EQE values were at the noise floor, below 0.002%. Index 8 (Sb 0.418) had the highest reading at 0.00041%. XRD shows trirutile CuSb2O6 (strong peak at Q≈1.91) across the mid-to-Sb-rich part of the line, and a different Cu-rich phase assemblage at Sb 0.24. Pt substrate peaks appear at 4.55 and 5.33. Under 2.1 eV illumination at pH 1.4, no composition I measured gave a meaningful photoresponse. Index 8 is best only by a margin that is within noise.
